brief:
Israeli forces demolished an inhabited house in Kafr al-Dik, a village west of Salfit in the northern West Bank, the Ma'an news agency reported. The demolition displaced the residents from their home.

The community of Kafr al-Dik has faced repeated demolitions of Palestinian-owned structures in recent years as Israeli authorities cite lack of building permits, a licensing process Palestinians say is nearly impossible to obtain in Area C, the zone under full Israeli control.
title: Israeli forces demolish inhabited home in Kafr al-Dik west of Salfit
